description: Scrape a single URL using Firecrawl's JS-rendering engine and return clean markdown (up to 100,000 chars), page title, and description. Strips navigation/boilerplate by default (only_main_content=true). Supports output formats: markdown, html, rawHtml, links.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Firecrawl API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

formats.description: Output formats to return (default ["markdown"]). Options include "markdown", "html", "rawHtml", "links".

only_main_content.description: Strip navigation, footers, and boilerplate, returning just the main content (default true).

name: scrape
title: Scrape
